articles.title: Building The Apex Calc: A Fast, Ad-Free Financial & Amortization Utility
articles.excerpt: Most online financial calculators are buried under invasive display ads, auto-playing video popups, and slow third-party analytics trackers. Trying to compute a mortgage amortization schedule or evalu…
articles.body: Most online financial calculators are buried under invasive display ads, auto-playing video popups, and slow third-party analytics trackers. Trying to compute a mortgage amortization schedule or evaluate a wage increase shouldn't feel like navigating an obstacle course. To fix this, I built The Apex Calc —a privacy-focused, zero-bloat financial computation suite. What it covers: Mortgage Payment & Amortization: Calculates monthly principal, interest, taxes, and schedule projections. Hourly-to-Salary Wage Converter: Real-time breakdown across weekly, monthly, and annual compensation with overtime adjustments. Compound Interest Modeling: Visualizing long-term wealth accumulation with periodic contributions.

articles.title: RouterOS at the Network Edge: Operational Risk From CVE-2026-67279 and CVE-2026-86060
articles.excerpt: RouterOS at the Network Edge: Operational Risk From CVE-2026-67279 and CVE-2026-86060 Vulnerability overview Most vulnerability write-ups describe mechanism. This one starts from position, because the…
articles.body: RouterOS at the Network Edge: Operational Risk From CVE-2026-67279 and CVE-2026-86060 Vulnerability overview Most vulnerability write-ups describe mechanism. This one starts from position, because the position is what makes the MikroTrick chain in MikroTik RouterOS worth a management conversation. RouterOS devices commonly sit on the boundary between an organisation and the internet, and the two flaws fixed on 3 September 2026 - CVE-2026-67279 and CVE-2026-86060 - end at full administrative control of precisely that device. Mechanism and exploitation conditions The first defect mishandles an SSH rekey performed during authentication and advances to the channel phase without an authenticated identity.

For that I use document.getElementsByTagname (this wrapped in a method,called ' getTagNames() ') . It's okay and I get things done with it. articles.body: The CW has produced more than its fair share of DC superhero shows over the years, from The Flash and Supergirl to Legends of Tomorrow and Black Lightning . Some remain favorites in their own right, while others became memorable for just how wonderfully weird the shared universe eventually became. The CW’s superhero stint was packed with crossovers, alternate Earths, time travel, and even multiversal crises, the likes of which Marvel could only dream. It eventually got to a point where keeping track of all the interconnected storylines and varied characters felt like a part-time job.

articles.title: 12 Years Ago, Doctor Who's Most Unhinged Episode Revealed the Doctor at His Worst
articles.excerpt: Peter Capaldi's Twelfth Doctor has plenty of outstanding moments, but one episode in particular shows the Time Lord at his worst.
articles.body: Doctor Who has never shied away from occasionally showing the Doctor at his worst. In “A Good Man Goes to War,” Eleven (Matt Smith) reckons with how his choices have made him nearly as monstrous as his enemies. There’s also “The Waters of Mars,” where Ten (David Tennant) is still reeling from the loss of his most recent companion, Donna Noble (Catherine Tate), and determined to win for once. He uses his power over time to save people whose deaths are fixed points in history — consequences be damned — in a genuinely shocking, villainous moment for the Time Lord.

articles.body: Disney has reportedly picked Spider-Man director Jon Watts to helm the first movie in Simon Kinberg's new Star Wars trilogy as it plots out the next chapter in the Skywalker Saga. Information about a new series of Star Wars projects from Lucasfilm was first reported by Daniel Richtman and later corroborated by The Hollywood Reporter . Although Watts is best known for leading the charge on the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Tom Holland Spider-Man trilogy, his work on Star Wars would represent his return to the sci-fi franchise following his time as co-creator on 2024's Skeleton Crew . The yet-to-be-named new films, which are said to be the next chapter in the Skywalker Saga, are being written by Star Wars: Rebels and Mr. and Mrs. Smith veteran Kinberg.

articles.title: NASA Tests Dual Mode Propulsion CubeSat Ahead of Launch
articles.excerpt: Spacecraft propulsion traditionally relies on volatile fuels and separate, bulky systems for different types of maneuvering in space. NASA is working to change that paradigm. Engineers at NASA’s Marsh…
articles.body: Spacecraft propulsion traditionally relies on volatile fuels and separate, bulky systems for different types of maneuvering in space. NASA is working to change that paradigm. Engineers at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, recently completed a rigorous series of environmental and physical tests on a new small satellite designed to make spaceflight safer and more efficient. The ASCENT (Advanced Spacecraft Energetic Non-Toxic) Propulsion Dual Mode mission is a flight demonstration of a spacecraft about the size of a large shoebox.
